back: A run of consecutive points of a series. All windows of length m are the n − m + 1 subsequences.
Motif = window with a very similar neighbour (low value). Discord = window unlike all others (high value, anomaly).
To compare shape only, ignoring level and scale.
A Python library that computes the matrix profile. stumpy.stump(T, m) returns the profile and nearest-neighbour index.

front: How do you cluster time series?
back: Z-normalise each series, then k-means (Euclidean) or DTW-based k-means if time shifts matter.
